character: Salzburg province's glacier ski area above Kaprun, reaching 3,029 m and usually opening in October, with the town's Maiskogel linked to the glacier by gondola. It is known for its snow parks and marked freeride lines.
learning: Search summary: about half of the piste km are rated easy. Reference note: beginners usually start on the Maiskogel or the glacier plateau; confirm ski schools and lessons.

announcedOpening.text: Season start planned 10 Oct 2026, snow permitting; skiing through May 2027.
